body.text: Śatasāhasrikā Prajñaparamitā
body.translated_text: <s>Śatasāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā</s> (The Perfection of Wisdom in One Hundred Thousand Lines)

body.text: oṃ namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ.
body.translated_text: Oṃ! Homage to all <s>Buddha</s>s and <s>Bodhisattva</s>s!

body.text: pṛthivīdhātvasattayāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra pūrvāntato bodhisattvo nopaiti, pṛthivīdhātuśūnyatayā pūrvāntato bodhisattvo nopaiti, pṛthivīdhātuviviktatayā pūrvāntato bodhisattvo nopaiti, pṛthivīdhātvasvabhāvatayā pūrvāntato bodhisattvo nopaiti, pṛthivīdhātvasattayāparāntato bodhisattvo nopaiti, pṛthivīdhātuśūnyatayāparāntato bodhisattvo nopaiti, pṛthivīdhātuviviktatayāparāntato bodhisattvo nopaiti, pṛthivīdhātvasvabhāvatayāparāntato bodhisattvo nopaiti, pṛthivīdhātvasattayā madhyato bodhisattvo nopaiti, pṛthivīdhātuśūnyatayā madhyato bodhisattvo nopaiti, pṛthivīdhātuviviktatayā madhyato bodhisattvo nopaiti, pṛthivīdhātvasvabhāvatayā madhyato bodhisattvo nopaiti. tat kasya hetoḥ? na hy āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra pṛthivīdhātvasattāyāṃ pṛthivīdhātuśūnyatāyāṃ pṛthivīdhātuviviktatāyāṃ pṛthivīdhātvasvabhāvatāyāṃ pūrvānta upalabhyate nāparānta upalabhyate na madhyam upalabhyate. na cānyā pṛthivīdhātvasattānyā pṛthivīdhātuśūnyatānyā pṛthivīdhātuviviktatānyā pṛthivīdhātvasvabhāvatānyo bodhisattvo 'nyaḥ pūrvānto 'nyo 'parānto 'nyan madhyam iti hy āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra yā ca pṛthivīdhātvasattā yā ca pṛthivīdhātuśūnyatā yā ca pṛthivīdhātuviviktatā yā ca pṛthivīdhātvasvabhāvatā yaś ca bodhisattvo yaś ca pūrvānto yaś cāparānto yac ca madhyaṃ sarvam etad advayam advaidhīkāram.
body.translated_text: By the non-existence (<s>asattā</s>) of the earth element, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the past; by the emptiness (<s>śūnyatā</s>) of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the past; by the isolation (<s>viviktatā</s>) of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the past; by the essencelessness (<s>asvabhāvatā</s>) of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the past; by the non-existence of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the future; by the emptiness of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the future; by the isolation of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the future; by the essencelessness of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the future; by the non-existence of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the middle [present]; by the emptiness of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the middle; by the isolation of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the middle; by the essencelessness of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s> does not approach from the middle. Why is that? Because, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, in the non-existence of the earth element, in the emptiness of the earth element, in the isolation of the earth element, in the essencelessness of the earth element, no past is apprehended, no future is apprehended, no middle is apprehended. And the non-existence of the earth element is not one thing, the emptiness of the earth element another, the isolation of the earth element another, the essencelessness of the earth element another, the <s>bodhisattva</s> another, the past another, the future another, and the middle another — for, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-existence of the earth element, the emptiness of the earth element, the isolation of the earth element, the essencelessness of the earth element, the <s>bodhisattva</s>, the past, the future, and the middle — all this is non-dual (<s>advaya</s>), undivided (<s>advaidhīkāra</s>).

body.text: yat punar āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra evaṃ vadasi, kena kāraṇena rūpaṃ bodhisattva ity evam api na saṃvidyate nopalabhata iti, kena kāraṇena vedanā bodhisattva ity evam api na saṃvidyate nopalabhyata iti, saṃjñā bodhisattva ity evam api na saṃvidyate nopalabhyata iti, saṃskārā bodhisattva ity evam api na saṃvidyate nopalabhyata iti, vijñānaṃ bodhisattva ity evam api na saṃvidyate nopalabhyata iti. rūpam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra rūpena śūnyam. tat kasya hetoḥ? na hi śūnyatāyāṃ rūpaṃ saṃvidyate na bodhisattvaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa rūpaṃ bodhisattva ity evam api na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate. vedanā vedanayā śūnyā. tat kasya hetoḥ? na hi śūnyatāyāṃ rūpaṃ saṃvidyate na bodhisattvaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa vedanā bodhisattva ity evam api na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate. saṃjñā saṃjñayā śūnyā. tat kasya hetoḥ? na hi śūnyatāyāṃ saṃjñā saṃvidyate na bodhisattvaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa saṃjñā bodhisattva ity evam api na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate. saṃskārāḥ saṃskāraiḥ śūnyāḥ. tat kasya hetoḥ? na hi śūnyatāyāṃ saṃskārāḥ saṃvidyate na bodhisattvaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa saṃskārā bodhisattva ity evam api na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate. vijñānaṃ vijñānena śūnyam. tat kasya hetoḥ? na hi śūnyatāyāṃ vijñānaṃ saṃvidyate na bodhisattvaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa vijñānaṃ bodhisattva ity evam api na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate.
body.translated_text: As for your further statement, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, 'For what reason is even [the identification] "form is a <s>bodhisattva</s>" not found, not apprehended?', 'For what reason is even "feeling is a <s>bodhisattva</s>" not found, not apprehended?', '"perception is a <s>bodhisattva</s>" — even this is not found, not apprehended,' '"formations are a <s>bodhisattva</s>" — even this is not found, not apprehended,' '"consciousness is a <s>bodhisattva</s>" — even this is not found, not apprehended' — form, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of form. Why is that? Because in emptiness, neither form is found nor the <s>bodhisattva</s>; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, even 'form is a <s>bodhisattva</s>' is not found, not apprehended. Feeling is empty of feeling. Why is that? Because in emptiness, neither form is found nor the <s>bodhisattva</s>; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, even 'feeling is a <s>bodhisattva</s>' is not found, not apprehended. Perception is empty of perception. Why is that? Because in emptiness, neither perception is found nor the <s>bodhisattva</s>; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, even 'perception is a <s>bodhisattva</s>' is not found, not apprehended. Formations are empty of formations. Why is that? Because in emptiness, neither formations are found nor the <s>bodhisattva</s>; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, even 'formations are a <s>bodhisattva</s>' is not found, not apprehended. Consciousness is empty of consciousness. Why is that? Because in emptiness, neither consciousness is found nor the <s>bodhisattva</s>; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, even 'consciousness is a <s>bodhisattva</s>' is not found, not apprehended.

body.translated_text: the noble truths, <s>dhyāna</s>s, immeasurables, formless attainments, liberations, sequential abiding attainments, gates of liberation, superknowledges, and concentrations are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dhāraṇī</s>-gates;

body.text: dhāraṇīmukhāni dhāraṇīmukheṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dhāraṇī</s>-gates are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dhāraṇī</s>-gates;

body.text: dhāraṇīmukhāny āryasatyadhyānāpramāṇārūpyasamāpattivimokṣānupūrvavihārasamāpattivimokṣamukhābhijñāsamādhiṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante.
body.translated_text: the <s>dhāraṇī</s>-gates are not found, not apprehended, in the noble truths, <s>dhyāna</s>s, immeasurables, formless attainments, liberations, sequential abiding attainments, gates of liberation, superknowledges, and concentrations.

body.text: tathāgatabalāni tathāgatabaleṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: The <s>Tathāgata</s> powers are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>Tathāgata</s> powers;

body.text: tathāgatabalāni vaiśāradyeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>Tathāgata</s> powers are not found, not apprehended, in the fearlessnesses (<s>vaiśāradya</s>);

body.text: vaiśāradyāni vaiśāradyeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the fearlessnesses are not found, not apprehended, in the fearlessnesses;

body.text: vaiśāradyāni tathāgatabaleṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the fearlessnesses are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>Tathāgata</s> powers;

body.text: tathāgatabalāni vaiśāradyāni ca pratisaṃvitsu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>Tathāgata</s> powers and fearlessnesses are not found, not apprehended, in the discriminating knowledges (<s>pratisaṃvid</s>);

body.text: pratisaṃvidaḥ pratisaṃvitsu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the discriminating knowledges are not found, not apprehended, in the discriminating knowledges;

body.text: pratisaṃvidas tathāgatabalavaiśāradyeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the discriminating knowledges are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>Tathāgata</s> powers and fearlessnesses;

body.text: tathāgatabalavaiśāradyapratisaṃvida āveṇikabuddhadharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>Tathāgata</s> powers, fearlessnesses, and discriminating knowledges are not found, not apprehended, in the unique qualities of the <s>Buddha</s> (<s>āveṇikabuddhadharma</s>);

body.text: āveṇikabuddhadharmā āveṇikabuddhadharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the unique qualities of the <s>Buddha</s> are not found, not apprehended, in the unique qualities of the <s>Buddha</s>;

body.text: āveṇikabuddhadharmās tathāgatabalavaiśāradyapratisaṃvitsu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante.
body.translated_text: the unique qualities of the <s>Buddha</s> are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>Tathāgata</s> powers, fearlessnesses, and discriminating knowledges.

body.text: gotrabhūdharmā gotrabhūdharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: The <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage (<s>gotrabhū</s>) are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage;

body.text: gotrabhūdharmā aṣṭamakadharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the eighth [stage] (<s>aṣṭamaka</s>);

body.text: aṣṭamakadharmā aṣṭamakadharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the eighth stage are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the eighth stage;

body.text: aṣṭamakadharmā gotrabhūdharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the eighth stage are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage;

body.text: gotrabhūdharmā aṣṭamakadharmāś ca srotaāpattidharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage and the eighth stage are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of stream-entry (<s>srotaāpatti</s>);

body.text: srotaāpattidharmāḥ srotaāpattidharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of stream-entry are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of stream-entry;

body.text: srotaāpattidharmā gotrabhūdharmāṣṭamakadharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante.
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of stream-entry are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage and the eighth stage.

body.text: gotrabhūdharmā aṣṭakadharmāḥ srotaāpattidharmāḥ sakṛdāgāmidharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: The <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage, the eighth stage, and stream-entry are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of once-returning (<s>sakṛdāgāmin</s>);

body.text: sakṛdāgāmidharmāḥ sakṛdāgāmidharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of once-returning are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of once-returning;

body.text: sakṛdāgāmidharmā gotrabhūdharmāṣṭmakadharmasrotaāpannadharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of once-returning are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage, the eighth stage, and the stream-enterer.

body.text: gotrabhūdharmā aṣṭamakadharmāḥ srotaāpannadharmāḥ sakṛdāgāmidharmā anāgāmidharmā arhattvadharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: The <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage, the eighth stage, the stream-enterer, the once-returner, and the non-returner are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of <s>arhat</s>ship;

body.text: anāgāmidharmā anāgāmidharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the non-returner (<s>anāgāmin</s>) are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the non-returner;

body.text: anāgāmidharmā gotrabhūdharmāṣṭamakadharmasrotaāpannadharmasakṛdāgāmidharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the non-returner are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage, the eighth stage, the stream-enterer, and the once-returner;

body.text: gotrabhūdharmā aṣṭamakadharmāḥ srotaāpannadharmāḥ sakṛdāgāmidharmā anāgāmidharmā arhaddharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage, the eighth stage, the stream-enterer, the once-returner, and the non-returner are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the <s>arhat</s>;

body.text: arhaddharmā arhaddharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the <s>arhat</s> are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the <s>arhat</s>;

body.text: arhaddharmā gotrabhūdharmāṣṭamakadharmaśrotaāpannadharmasakṛdāgāmidharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the <s>arhat</s> are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage, the eighth stage, the stream-enterer, and the once-returner;

body.text: gotrabhūdharmā aṣṭamakadharmāḥ srotaāpannadharmāḥ sakṛdāgāmidharmā arhaddharmāḥ pratyekabuddhadharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage, the eighth stage, the stream-enterer, the once-returner, and the <s>arhat</s> are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the <s>pratyekabuddha</s>;

body.text: pratyekabuddhadharmāḥ pratyekabuddhadharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the <s>pratyekabuddha</s> are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the <s>pratyekabuddha</s>;

body.text: pratyekabuddhadharmā gotrabhūdharmāṣṭamakadharmasrotaāpannadharmasakṛdāgāmidharmānāgāmidharmārhaddharmeṣu na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante.
body.translated_text: the <s>dharma</s>s of the <s>pratyekabuddha</s> are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>dharma</s>s of the lineage-stage, the eighth stage, the stream-enterer, the once-returner, the non-returner, and the <s>arhat</s>.

body.text: pṛthagjanabhūmiḥ pṛthagjanabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: The ordinary being's stage (<s>pṛthagjana-bhūmi</s>) is not found, not apprehended, in the ordinary being's stage;

body.text: pṛthagjanabhūmir gotrabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the ordinary being's stage is not found, not apprehended, in the lineage-stage (<s>gotra-bhūmi</s>);

body.text: gotrabhūmir gotrabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the lineage-stage is not found, not apprehended, in the lineage-stage;

body.text: gotrabhūmiḥ pṛthagjanabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the lineage-stage is not found, not apprehended, in the ordinary being's stage;

body.text: pṛthagjanabhūmir gotrabhūmiś cāṣṭamakabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the ordinary being's stage and the lineage-stage are not found, not apprehended, in the eighth stage (<s>aṣṭamaka-bhūmi</s>);

body.text: aṣṭamakabhūmir aṣṭamakabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate.
body.translated_text: the eighth stage is not found, not apprehended, in the eighth stage.

body.text: aṣṭamakabhūmiḥ pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: The eighth stage is not found, not apprehended, in the ordinary being's stage and the lineage-stage;

body.text: pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmayo darśanabhūmau na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, and eighth stage are not found, not apprehended, in the stage of seeing (<s>darśana-bhūmi</s>);

body.text: darśanabhūmir darśanabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the stage of seeing is not found, not apprehended, in the stage of seeing;

body.text: darśanabhūmiḥ pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmiṣu na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the stage of seeing is not found, not apprehended, in the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, and eighth stage;

body.text: pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmayas tanubhūmau na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, and stage of seeing are not found, not apprehended, in the stage of thinning (<s>tanu-bhūmi</s>);

body.text: tanubhūmis tanubhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the stage of thinning is not found, not apprehended, in the stage of thinning;

body.text: tanubhūmiḥ pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmiṣu na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the stage of thinning is not found, not apprehended, in the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, and stage of seeing;

body.text: pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmitanubhūmayo vītarāgabhūmau na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, stage of seeing, and stage of thinning are not found, not apprehended, in the stage of freedom from passion (<s>vītarāga-bhūmi</s>);

body.text: vītarāgabhūmir vītarāgabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the stage of freedom from passion is not found, not apprehended, in the stage of freedom from passion;

body.text: vītarāgabhūmiḥ pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmitanubhūmiṣu na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the stage of freedom from passion is not found, not apprehended, in the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, stage of seeing, and stage of thinning;

body.text: pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmitanubhūmivītarāgabhūmayaḥ kṛtāvibhūmau na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, stage of seeing, stage of thinning, and stage of freedom from passion are not found, not apprehended, in the stage of the adept (<s>kṛtāvi-bhūmi</s>);

body.text: kṛtāvibhūmiḥ kṛtāvibhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the stage of the adept is not found, not apprehended, in the stage of the adept;

body.text: kṛtāvibhūmiḥ pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmitanubhūmivītarāgabhūmiṣu na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the stage of the adept is not found, not apprehended, in the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, stage of seeing, stage of thinning, and stage of freedom from passion;

body.text: pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmitanubhūmivītarāgabhūmikṛtāvibhūmayaḥ pratyakabuddhabhūmau na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, stage of seeing, stage of thinning, stage of freedom from passion, and stage of the adept are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>pratyekabuddha</s>-stage;

body.text: pratyekabuddhabhūmiḥ pratyekabuddhabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the <s>pratyekabuddha</s>-stage is not found, not apprehended, in the <s>pratyekabuddha</s>-stage;

body.text: pratyekabuddhabhūmiḥ pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmitanubhūmivītarāgabhūmikṛtāvibhūmiṣu (
body.translated_text: the <s>pratyekabuddha</s>-stage is not found, not apprehended, in the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, stage of seeing, stage of thinning, stage of freedom from passion, and stage of the adept

body.text: pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmitanubhūmivītarāgabhūmikṛtāvibhūmipratyekabuddhabhūmayo bodhisattvabhūmau na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, stage of seeing, stage of thinning, stage of freedom from passion, stage of the adept, and <s>pratyekabuddha</s>-stage are not found, not apprehended, in the <s>bodhisattva</s>-stage;

body.text: bodhisattvabhūmir bodhisattvabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate.
body.translated_text: the <s>bodhisattva</s>-stage is not found, not apprehended, in the <s>bodhisattva</s>-stage.

body.text: bodhisattvabhūmiḥ pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmitanubhūmivītarāgabhūmikṛtāvibhūmipratyekabuddhabhūmiṣu na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: The <s>bodhisattva</s>-stage is not found, not apprehended, in the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, stage of seeing, stage of thinning, stage of freedom from passion, stage of the adept, and <s>pratyekabuddha</s>-stage;

body.text: pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmitanubhūmivītarāgabhūmikṛtāvibhūmipratyekabuddhabhūmibodhisattvabhūmayaḥ samyakṣaṃbuddhabhūmau na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, stage of seeing, stage of thinning, stage of freedom from passion, stage of the adept, <s>pratyekabuddha</s>-stage, and <s>bodhisattva</s>-stage are not found, not apprehended, in the stage of the perfectly enlightened <s>Buddha</s> (<s>samyaksaṃbuddha-bhūmi</s>);

body.text: samyakṣaṃbuddhabhūmiḥ samyakṣaṃbuddhabhūmau na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the stage of the perfectly enlightened <s>Buddha</s> is not found, not apprehended, in the stage of the perfectly enlightened <s>Buddha</s>;

body.text: samyakṣaṃbuddhabhūmiḥ pṛthagjanabhūmigotrabhūmyaṣṭamakabhūmidarśanabhūmitanubhūmivītarāgabhūmikṛtāvibhūmipratyekabuddhabhūmibodhisattvabhūmiṣu na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate.
body.translated_text: the stage of the perfectly enlightened <s>Buddha</s> is not found, not apprehended, in the ordinary being's stage, lineage-stage, eighth stage, stage of seeing, stage of thinning, stage of freedom from passion, stage of the adept, <s>pratyekabuddha</s>-stage, and <s>bodhisattva</s>-stage.

body.text: sarvajñatā sarvajñatāyāṃ na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: Omniscience (<s>sarvajñatā</s>) is not found, not apprehended, in omniscience;

body.text: sarvajñatā mārgākārajñatāyāṃ na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: omniscience is not found, not apprehended, in the knowledge of the paths (<s>mārgākārajñatā</s>);

body.text: mārgākārajñatā mārgākārajñatāyāṃ na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the knowledge of the paths is not found, not apprehended, in the knowledge of the paths;

body.text: mārgākārajñatā sarvākārajñatāyāṃ na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the knowledge of the paths is not found, not apprehended, in the knowledge of all aspects (<s>sarvākārajñatā</s>);

body.text: sarvajñatā mārgākārajñatā ca sarvākārajñatāyāṃ na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: omniscience and the knowledge of the paths are not found, not apprehended, in the knowledge of all aspects;

body.text: sarvākārajñatā sarvākārajñatāyāṃ na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: the knowledge of all aspects is not found, not apprehended, in the knowledge of all aspects;

body.text: sarvākārajñatā sarvajñatāmārgākārajñatayor na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate.
body.translated_text: the knowledge of all aspects is not found, not apprehended, in omniscience and the knowledge of the paths.

body.text: srotaāpannaḥ srotaāpanne na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: A stream-enterer (<s>srotaāpanna</s>) is not found, not apprehended, in a stream-enterer;

body.text: srotaāpannaḥ sakṛdāgāmini na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: a stream-enterer is not found, not apprehended, in a once-returner (<s>sakṛdāgāmin</s>);

body.text: sakṛdāgāmī sakṛdāgāmini na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: a once-returner is not found, not apprehended, in a once-returner;

body.text: sakṛdāgāmī srotaāpanne na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: a once-returner is not found, not apprehended, in a stream-enterer;

body.text: srotaāpannaḥ sakṛdāgāmī cānāgāmini na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: a stream-enterer and a once-returner are not found, not apprehended, in a non-returner (<s>anāgāmin</s>);

body.text: anāgāmy anāgāmini na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: a non-returner is not found, not apprehended, in a non-returner;

body.text: anāgāmī srotaāpannasakṛdāgāmini ca na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: a non-returner is not found, not apprehended, in a stream-enterer and a once-returner;

body.text: srotaāpannasakṛdāgāmyanāgāmino 'rhati na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: a stream-enterer, once-returner, and non-returner are not found, not apprehended, in an <s>arhat</s>;

body.text: arhan arhati na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: an <s>arhat</s> is not found, not apprehended, in an <s>arhat</s>;

body.text: arhan srotaāpannasakṛdāgāmyanāgāmiṣu na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: an <s>arhat</s> is not found, not apprehended, in a stream-enterer, once-returner, and non-returner;

body.text: srotaāpannasakṛdāgāmyanāgāmyarhantaḥ pratyekabuddhe na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante,
body.translated_text: a stream-enterer, once-returner, non-returner, and <s>arhat</s> are not found, not apprehended, in a <s>pratyekabuddha</s>;

body.text: pratyekabuddhaḥ pratyekabuddhe na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: a <s>pratyekabuddha</s> is not found, not apprehended, in a <s>pratyekabuddha</s>;

body.text: pratyekabuddhaḥ srotaāpannasakṛdāgāmyanāgāmyarhatsu na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate,
body.translated_text: a <s>pratyekabuddha</s> is not found, not apprehended, in a stream-enterer, once-returner, non-returner, and <s>arhat</s>;

body.text: evam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra sarvadharmeṣv asaṃvidyamāneṣv anupalabhamāneṣu bodhisattvo na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate.
body.translated_text: Thus, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, when all <s>dharma</s>s are not found, not apprehended, the <s>bodhisattva</s> is not found, not apprehended.

body.text: yat punar āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputraivaṃ vadasi kena kāraṇena nāmadheyamātram etad yad uta punar bodhisattva iti.
body.translated_text: As for your further statement, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, 'For what reason is this a mere designation, namely "<s>bodhisattva</s>"?'

body.text: āgantukam etad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra nāmadheyaṃ prakṣiptaṃ yad uta bodhisattva iti, tena kāraṇenocyate nāmadheyamātram etad yad uta bodhisattva iti.
body.translated_text: This designation, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is adventitious, imposed — namely '<s>bodhisattva</s>.' For that reason it is said, 'This is a mere designation, namely "<s>bodhisattva</s>."'

body.text: āgantukam etad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra nāmadheyaṃ prakṣiptaṃ yad uta rūpam iti vedaneti saṃjñeti saṃskārā iti vijñānam iti, tathā hi nāma na kutaścid āgacchati na kvacid gacchati na kvacit tiṣṭhati, yac ca nāmadheyamātrañ ca na tad rūpaṃ na sā vedanā na sā saṃjñā na te saṃskārā na tad vijñānam. tat kasya hetoḥ? tathā hi nāma śūnyaṃ nāma svabhāvena yac ca śūnyaṃ na tan nāma tena kāraṇenocyate nāmadheyamātram etad yad uta bodhisattva iti.
body.translated_text: This designation, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is adventitious, imposed — namely 'form,' 'feeling,' 'perception,' 'formations,' 'consciousness.' For a name does not come from anywhere, does not go anywhere, does not abide anywhere; and what is a mere designation — that is not form, not feeling, not perception, not formations, not consciousness. Why is that? For a name is empty of name by its own nature; and what is empty — that is not a name. For that reason it is said, 'This is a mere designation, namely "<s>bodhisattva</s>."'

body.text: āgantukam etad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra nāmadheyaṃ prakṣiptaṃ yad uta cakṣur iti śrotram iti ghrāṇam iti jihveti kāya iti mana iti, tathā hi nāma na kutaścid āgacchati na kvacid gacchati na kvacit tiṣṭhati, yac ca nāmadheyamātraṃ na tac cakṣur na śrotraṃ na tad ghrāṇaṃ na sā jihvā na sa kāyo na tan manaḥ. tat kasya hetoḥ? tathā hi nāma śūnyaṃ nāma svabhāvena yac ca śūnyaṃ na tan nāma tena kāraṇenocyate nāmadheyamātram etad yad uta bodhisattva iti.
body.translated_text: This designation, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is adventitious, imposed — namely 'eye,' 'ear,' 'nose,' 'tongue,' 'body,' 'mind.' For a name does not come from anywhere, does not go anywhere, does not abide anywhere; and what is a mere designation — that is not eye, not ear, not nose, not tongue, not body, not mind. Why is that? For a name is empty of name by its own nature; and what is empty — that is not a name. For that reason it is said, 'This is a mere designation, namely "<s>bodhisattva</s>."'

body.text: āgantukam etad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra nāmadheyaṃ prakṣiptaṃ yad uta rūpam iti śabda iti gandha iti rasa iti sparśa iti dharmā iti, tathā hi nāma na kutaścid āgacchati na kvacid gacchati na kvacit tiṣṭhati, yac ca nāmadheyamātraṃ na tad rūpaṃ na sa śabdo na gandho na sa raso na sa sparśo na te dharmāḥ. tat kasya hetoḥ? tathā hi nāma śūnyaṃ nāma svabhāvena yac ca śūnyaṃ na tan nāma tena kāraṇenocyate nāmadheyamātram etad yad uta bodhisattva iti.

Why is that? For a name is empty of name by its own nature; and what is empty — that is not a name. For that reason it is said, 'This is a mere designation, namely "<s>bodhisattva</s>."'

body.translated_text: This designation, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is adventitious, imposed — namely '<s>avidyā</s> (ignorance),' '<s>saṃskāras</s> (formations),' '<s>vijñāna</s> (consciousness),' '<s>nāmarūpa</s> (name-and-form),' '<s>ṣaḍāyatana</s> (six sense-bases),' '<s>sparśa</s> (contact),' '<s>vedanā</s> (feeling),' '<s>tṛṣṇā</s> (craving),' '<s>upādāna</s> (clinging),' '<s>bhava</s> (existence),' '<s>jāti</s> (birth),' '<s>jarāmaraṇa</s> (aging-and-death).' For a name does not come from anywhere, does not go anywhere, does not abide anywhere; and what is a mere designation — that is not <s>avidyā</s>, not <s>saṃskāras</s>, not <s>vijñāna</s>, not <s>nāmarūpa</s>, not <s>ṣaḍāyatana</s>, not <s>sparśa</s>, not <s>vedanā</s>, not <s>tṛṣṇā</s>, not <s>upādāna</s>, not <s>bhava</s>, not <s>jāti</s>, not <s>jarāmaraṇa</s>. Why is that? For a name is empty — a name [is empty] by its own nature;

body.text: punar aparam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra nāmadheyamātram etad yad uta dānapāramitā na ca nāmni dānapāramitā na ca dānapāramitāyāṃ nāma. tat kasya hetoḥ? tathā hi yac ca nāma yā ca dānapāramitā ubhayam etan na saṃvidyate nopalabhyate, tasmān nāmadheyamātram etad yad uta bodhisattva iti.
body.translated_text: Furthermore, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, 'the perfection of giving (<s>dānapāramitā</s>)' is a mere designation; the perfection of giving is not in the name, nor is the name in the perfection of giving. Why is that? For the name and the perfection of giving — both of these are not found, not apprehended. Therefore, 'this is a mere designation, namely "<s>bodhisattva</s>."'

body.text: smṛtyupasthānāny āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputrāsaṃskṛtāṇi na ca kasyacid vigamena, samyakprahāṇāny asaṃskṛtāni na ca kasyacid vigamena, ṛddhipādāsaṃskṛtā na ca kasyacid vigamena, indriyāṇy asaṃskṛtāni na ca kasyacid vigamena, balāny asaṃskṛtāni na ca kasyacid vigamena, bodhyaṅgāni 'saṃskṛtāṇi na ca kasyacid vigamena, āryāṣṭāṇgo mārgo 'saṃskṛto na ca kasyacid vigamena. āryasatyāny āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputrāsaṃskṛtāni na ca kasyacid vigamena, dhyānāny asaṃskṛtāni na ca kasyacid vigamena, apramāṇāny asaṃskṛtāni na ca kasyacid vigamena, ārūpyasamāpattayo 'saṃskṛtā na ca kasyacid vigamena, aṣṭau vimokṣāsaṃskṛtā na ca kasyacid vigamena, navānupūrvavihārasamāpattayo 'saṃskṛtā na ca kasyacid vigamena, śūnyatānimittāpranihitavimokṣamukhāny asaṃskṛtāni na ca kasyacid vigamena, abhijñā asaṃskṛtā na ca kasyacid vigamena, samādhayo 'saṃskṛtā na ca kasyacid vigamena, dhāraṇīmukhāny asaṃskṛtāni na ca kasyacid vigamena, daśatathāgatabalāny asaṃskṛtāni na ca kasyacid vigamena, catvāri vaiśāradyāny asaṃskṛtāni na ca kasyacid vigamena, catasraḥ pratisaṃvido 'saṃskṛtā na ca kasyacid vigamena, mahāmaitry asaṃskṛtā na ca kasyacid vigamena, mahākaruṇāsaṃskṛtā na ca kasyacid vigamena, aṣṭādaśāveṇikā buddhadharmā asaṃskṛtā na ca kasyacid vigamena. tat kasya hetoḥ? tathā hy āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra yad asaṃskṛtaṃ so 'bhāvaḥ kṣayaś ca. anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa sarvadharmā asaṃskṛtā na ca kasyacid vigamena.
body.translated_text: The foundations of mindfulness (<s>smṛtyupasthāna</s>), Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, are unconditioned (<s>asaṃskṛta</s>) and do not depart from anyone; the right efforts (<s>samyakprahāṇa</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the bases of supernatural power (<s>ṛddhipāda</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the faculties (<s>indriya</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the powers (<s>bala</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the factors of awakening (<s>bodhyaṅga</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the noble eightfold path (<s>āryāṣṭāṅgamārga</s>) is unconditioned and does not depart from anyone. The noble truths (<s>āryasatya</s>), Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the meditative absorptions (<s>dhyāna</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the immeasurables (<s>apramāṇa</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the formless attainments (<s>ārūpyasamāpatti</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the eight liberations (<s>vimokṣa</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the nine successive abiding attainments (<s>anupūrvavihārasamāpatti</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the gateways of liberation — emptiness, signlessness, and wishlessness (<s>śūnyatānimittāpraṇihitavimokṣamukha</s>) — are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the superknowledges (<s>abhijñā</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the concentrations (<s>samādhi</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the gateways of retention (<s>dhāraṇīmukha</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the ten powers of the <s>Tathāgata</s> (<s>tathāgatabala</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the four fearlessnesses (<s>vaiśāradya</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; the four analytical knowledges (<s>pratisaṃvid</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone; great loving-kindness (<s>mahāmaitrī</s>) is unconditioned and does not depart from anyone; great compassion (<s>mahākaruṇā</s>) is unconditioned and does not depart from anyone; the eighteen exclusive qualities of the <s>Buddha</s> (<s>āveṇikabuddhadharma</s>) are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone. Why is that? Because, Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, that which is unconditioned is non-existence and cessation. By this method, Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, all dharmas are unconditioned and do not depart from anyone.

body.text: punar aparam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputrākūṭasthā avināśinaḥ sarvadharmāḥ.
body.translated_text: Furthermore, Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, all dharmas are immutable (<s>akūṭastha</s>) and indestructible (<s>avināśin</s>).

body.text: āha: kim ity āyuṣman subhūte 'kūṭasthā avināśinaḥ sarvadharmāḥ?
body.translated_text: He said: Why, Venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, are all dharmas immutable and indestructible?

body.translated_text: Furthermore, Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, as to what you said — 'For what reason is form unproduced? For what reason is feeling unproduced? body.text: yat punar āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputraivam āha, kena kāraṇenaivaṃ vadasi, tat kim anabhinirvṛttaṃ prajñāpāramitāyām avavadiṣyām anuśāsiṣyāmīti?
body.translated_text: Now, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, as to your statement thus: 'For what reason do you speak thus — will I instruct and admonish that which is unproduced in the perfection of wisdom (<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>)?'

body.text: tathā hy āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra yānabhinirvṛttiḥ sā prajñāpāramitā yā prajñāpāramitā sānābhinirvṛttir iti hy anabhinirvṛttiś ca prajñāpāramitā cābhāv etau dharmāv advayam advaidhīkāram.
body.translated_text: For indeed, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, non-production (<s>anabhinirvṛtti</s>) is the perfection of wisdom (<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>), and the perfection of wisdom is non-production — thus non-production and the perfection of wisdom, these two <s>dharma</s>s are non-dual (<s>advaya</s>) and undivided (<s>advaidhīkāra</s>).

body.text: anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇaivaṃ vadasi, tat kim anabhinirvṛttiṃ prajñāpāramitāyām avavadiṣyāmy anuśāsiṣyāmi.
body.translated_text: By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, you speak thus: 'Will I instruct and admonish the unproduced in the perfection of wisdom (<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>)?'

body.text: yat punar āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputraivam āha, kena kāraṇena nānyatrābhivṛttyā bodhisattva upalabhyate yo bodhāya cared iti. tathā hy āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāñ caran nānyam anabhinirvṛttim anyaṃ bodhisattvaṃ samanupaśyati. iti hy anabhinirvṛttiś ca bodhisattvaś cobhāv etau dharmāv advayam advaidhīkāram.
body.translated_text: Now, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, as to your statement thus: 'For what reason is a <s>bodhisattva</s> not found apart from production, who would practice for awakening?' — for indeed, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>, practicing in the perfection of wisdom (<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>), does not perceive any non-production as different from the <s>bodhisattva</s>. Thus non-production (<s>anabhinirvṛtti</s>) and the <s>bodhisattva</s>, these two <s>dharma</s>s are non-dual (<s>advaya</s>) and undivided (<s>advaidhīkāra</s>).

body.text: athāyuṣmāñ chāradvatīputra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtim etad avocat: katham āyuṣman subhūte bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ carann imān dharmān upaparīkṣate? katama āyuṣman subhūte bodhisattvaḥ? katamā prajñāpāramitā? katamopaparīkṣā?
body.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s> said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: How, O venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, does a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> practicing the perfection of wisdom (<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>) examine these <s>dharma</s>s? Who, O venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, is the <s>bodhisattva</s>? What is the perfection of wisdom? What is this examination (<s>upaparīkṣā</s>)?

body.text: evam ukte āyuṣmān subhūtir āyuṣmantaṃ śāradvatīputram etad avocat: yad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra evaṃ vadasi, katamo bodhisattva iti, bodhir eva sattvas tenocyate bodhisattva iti, tayā ca bodhyā sarvadharmāṇām ākārān jānāti na ca tān dharmān abhiniviśate. katameṣāṃ dharmāṇām ākārān jānāti?
body.translated_text: When this was said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>: As to your statement, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, 'Who is the <s>bodhisattva</s>?' — <s>bodhi</s> (awakening) itself is the being (<s>sattva</s>), therefore one is called a <s>bodhisattva</s>. And through that <s>bodhi</s> one knows the aspects (<s>ākāra</s>) of all <s>dharma</s>s, yet does not settle upon those <s>dharma</s>s. The aspects of which <s>dharma</s>s does one know?

body.translated_text: One knows the aspects of the meditative absorptions (<s>dhyāna</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of the immeasurables (<s>apramāṇa</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of the formless attainments (<s>ārūpyasamāpatti</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of the liberations (<s>vimokṣa</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of the successive meditative attainments (<s>anupūrvavihārasamāpatti</s>) but does not settle therein.

body.text: śūnyatānimittāpraṇihitavimokṣamukhānām ākārān jānāti na ca tatrābhiniviśate, abhijñānām ākārān jānāti na ca tatrābhiniviśate, samādhīnām ākārān jānāti na ca tatrābhiniviśate, dhāraṇīmukhānām ākārān jānāti na ca tatrābhiniviśate, tathāgatabalānām ākārān jānāti na ca tatrābhiniviśate, vaiśāradyānām ākārān jānāti na ca tatrābhiniviśate, pratisaṃvidām ākārān jānāti na ca tatrābhiniviśate, mahāmaitryā ākārān jānāti na ca tatrābhiniviśate, mahākaruṇāyā ākārān jānāti na ca tatrābhiniviśate, aṣṭādaśāveṇikabuddhadharmāṇām ākārān jānāti na ca tatrābhiniviśate.
body.translated_text: One knows the aspects of the gateways of liberation — emptiness, signlessness, and wishlessness (<s>śūnyatānimittāpraṇihitavimokṣamukha</s>) — but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of the superknowledges (<s>abhijñā</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of the concentrations (<s>samādhi</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of the gateways of retention (<s>dhāraṇīmukha</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of the powers of the <s>Tathāgata</s> (<s>tathāgatabala</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of the fearlessnesses (<s>vaiśāradya</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of the analytical knowledges (<s>pratisaṃvid</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of great loving-kindness (<s>mahāmaitrī</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of great compassion (<s>mahākaruṇā</s>) but does not settle therein; one knows the aspects of the eighteen exclusive qualities of a Buddha (<s>aṣṭādaśāveṇikabuddhadharma</s>) but does not settle therein.

body.text: āha: katame āyuṣman subhūte sarvadharmāṇām ākārāḥ?
body.translated_text: He said: What, Venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, are the aspects of all dharmas?

body.text: subhūtir āha: yair āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputrākārair yair liṅgair yair nimittaiḥ sarvadharmā ākāryante, yad uta rūpair vā śabdair vā gandhair vā rasair vā sparśair vā ādhyātmikair vā bāhyair vā dharmaiḥ saṃskṛtāsaṃskṛtā dharmā yair ākārair yair liṅgair yair nimittair ākāryante, ima ucyante sarvadharmāṇām ākārāḥ.
body.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the aspects, signs, and marks by which all dharmas are characterized — namely, by forms, sounds, smells, tastes, tangible objects, internal or external dharmas — the conditioned and unconditioned dharmas that are characterized by whatever aspects, signs, and marks — these are called the aspects of all dharmas.

body.text: yat punar āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputraivaṃ vadasi, katamā prajñāpāramiteti? āramitaiṣāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra yad ucyate prajñāpāramitā. kasmād āramitā? āramitāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra skandhebhyas tad ucyate.
body.translated_text: Furthermore, Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, you say: 'What is the perfection of wisdom (<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>)?' Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, it is called the perfection of wisdom because it is <s>āramitā</s> (one that has gone far). Why has it gone far? Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, it is called so because it has gone far from (<s>āramitā</s>) and turned away from (<s>āratā</s>) the aggregates (<s>skandha</s>).

body.text: āramitā āratā dhātubhyas tad ucyate, āramitā āratā āyatanebhyas tad ucyate, āramitā āratā sarvakleśebhyas tad ucyate, āramitā āratā sarvadṛṣṭigatebhyas tad ucyate, āramitā āratā ṣaḍbhyo gatibhyas tad ucyate.
body.translated_text: It has gone far from and turned away from the elements (<s>dhātu</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the sense-bases (<s>āyatana</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from all afflictions (<s>sarvakleśa</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from all wrong views (<s>sarvadṛṣṭigata</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the six destinies (<s>ṣaḍgati</s>), thus it is called so.

body.text: āramitā āratā dānapāramitāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā śīlapāramitāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā kṣāntipāramitāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā vīryapāramitāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā dhyānapāramitāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā prajñāpāramitāyās tad ucyate.
body.translated_text: It has gone far from and turned away from the perfection of giving (<s>dānapāramitā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the perfection of morality (<s>śīlapāramitā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the perfection of patience (<s>kṣāntipāramitā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the perfection of vigor (<s>vīryapāramitā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the perfection of meditation (<s>dhyānapāramitā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the perfection of wisdom (<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>), thus it is called so.

body.text: āramitā āratādhyātmaśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā bahirdhāśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratādhyātmabahirdhāśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā śūnyatāśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā mahāśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā paramārthaśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā saṃskṛtaśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratāsaṃskṛtaśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratātyantaśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratānavarāgraśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratānavakāraśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā prakṛtiśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā sarvadharmaśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā svalakṣaṇaśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratānupalambhaśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratābhāvaśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratā svabhāvaśūnyatāyās tad ucyate, āramitā āratābhāvasvabhāvaśūnyatāyās tad ucyate.
body.translated_text: It has gone far from and turned away from internal emptiness (<s>adhyātmaśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from external emptiness (<s>bahirdhāśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from internal-and-external emptiness (<s>adhyātmabahirdhāśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the emptiness of emptiness (<s>śūnyatāśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from great emptiness (<s>mahāśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from ultimate emptiness (<s>paramārthaśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the emptiness of the conditioned (<s>saṃskṛtaśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the emptiness of the unconditioned (<s>asaṃskṛtaśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the emptiness of the ultimate limit (<s>atyantaśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from emptiness of the beginningless and endless (<s>anavarāgraśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from emptiness of non-rejection (<s>anavakāraśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from natural emptiness (<s>prakṛtiśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from the emptiness of all dharmas (<s>sarvadharmaśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from emptiness of own-characteristics (<s>svalakṣaṇaśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from emptiness of non-apprehension (<s>anupalambhaśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from emptiness of non-existence (<s>abhāvaśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from emptiness of inherent nature (<s>svabhāvaśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so; it has gone far from and turned away from emptiness of non-existence and inherent nature (<s>abhāvasvabhāvaśūnyatā</s>), thus it is called so.

body.text: anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇāramitaiṣā yad uta prajñāpāramitā.
body.translated_text: By this method, Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, it has gone far — namely, the perfection of wisdom (<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>).

body.text: yat punar āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputraivaṃ vadasi, katamopaparīkṣaṇeti, ihāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caran na rūpaṃ nityam ity upaparīkṣate nānityam iti, na rūpaṃ sukham ity upaparīkṣate na duḥkham iti, na rūpam ātmety upaparīkṣate nānātmeti, na rūpaṃ śubham ity upaparīkṣate nāśubham iti, na rūpaṃ śūnyam ity upaparīkṣate nāśūnyam iti, na rūpaṃ nimittam ity upaparīkṣate nānimittam iti, na rūpaṃ praṇihitam ity upaparīkṣate nāpraṇihitam iti, na rūpaṃ śāntam ity upaparīkṣate nāśāntam iti, na rūpaṃ viviktam ity upaparīkṣate nāviviktam iti.
body.translated_text: Furthermore, Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, you say: 'What is the investigation (<s>upaparīkṣaṇa</s>)?' Here, Venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> practising the perfection of wisdom does not investigate form as permanent nor as impermanent; does not investigate form as pleasant nor as suffering; does not investigate form as self nor as non-self; does not investigate form as beautiful nor as ugly; does not investigate form as empty nor as non-empty; does not investigate form as having signs nor as signless; does not investigate form as having wishes nor as wishless; does not investigate form as peaceful nor as non-peaceful; does not investigate form as secluded nor as non-secluded.

body.text: na vedanāṃ nityety upaparīkṣate nānityeti, na vedanāṃ sukhety upaparīkṣate na duḥkheti, na vedanām ātmety upaparīkṣate nānātmeti, na vedanāṃ śubhety upaparīkṣate nāśubheti, na vedanāṃ śūnyety upaparīkṣate nāśūnyeti, na vedanāṃ nimittety upaparīkṣate nānimitteti, na vedanāṃ praṇihitety upaparīkṣate nāpraṇihiteti, na vedanāṃ śāntety upaparīkṣate nāśānteti, na vedanāṃ viviktety upaparīkṣate nāvivikteti.
body.translated_text: One does not investigate feeling (<s>vedanā</s>) as permanent nor as impermanent; does not investigate feeling as pleasant nor as suffering; does not investigate feeling as self nor as non-self; does not investigate feeling as beautiful nor as ugly; does not investigate feeling as empty nor as non-empty; does not investigate feeling as having signs nor as signless; does not investigate feeling as having wishes nor as wishless; does not investigate feeling as peaceful nor as non-peaceful; does not investigate feeling as secluded nor as non-secluded.

body.text: na saṃjñāṃ nityety upaparīkṣate nānityeti, na saṃjñāṃ sukhety upaparīkṣate na duḥkheti, na saṃjñām ātmety upaparīkṣate nānātmeti, na saṃjñāṃ śubhety upaparīkṣate nāśubheti, na saṃjñāṃ śūnyety upaparīkṣate nāśūnyeti, na saṃjñāṃ nimittety upaparīkṣate nānimitteti, na saṃjñāṃ praṇihitety upaparīkṣate nāpraṇihiteti, na saṃjñāṃ śāntety upaparīkṣate nāśānteti, na saṃjñāṃ viviktety upaparīkṣate nāvivikteti.
body.translated_text: One does not investigate perception (<s>saṃjñā</s>) as permanent nor as impermanent; does not investigate perception as pleasant nor as suffering; does not investigate perception as self nor as non-self; does not investigate perception as beautiful nor as ugly; does not investigate perception as empty nor as non-empty; does not investigate perception as having signs nor as signless; does not investigate perception as having wishes nor as wishless; does not investigate perception as peaceful nor as non-peaceful; does not investigate perception as secluded nor as non-secluded.

children.text: ) yaḥ ṣaḍāyatanasyānutpādo na sa ṣaḍāyatanaṃ, yaḥ sparśasyānutpādo na sa sparśaḥ, yo vedanāyā anutpādo na sā vedanā, yas tṛṣṇāyā anutpādo na sā tṛṣṇā, ya upādānasyānutpādo na tad upādānaṃ, yo bhavasyānutpādo na sa bhavaḥ, yo jāter anutpādo na sā jātiḥ, yo jarāmaraṇasyānutpādo na taj jarāmaraṇam.

body.translated_text: For what reason, O venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, do you say this — the non-arising of ignorance (<s>avidyā</s>) is not that ignorance; the non-arising of formations is not those formations; the non-arising of consciousness is not that consciousness; the non-arising of name-and-form is not that name-and-form (

body.text: kena kāraṇenāyuṣman subhūte evaṃ vadasi, yo dānapāramitāyā anutpādo na sā dānapāramitā, yaḥ śīlapāramitāyā anutpādo na sā śīlapāramitā, yaḥ kṣāntipāramitāyā anutpādo na sā kṣāntipāramitā, yo vīryapāramitāyā anutpādo na sā vīryapāramitā, yo dhyānapāramitāyā anutpādo na sā dhyānapāramitā, yaḥ prajñāpāramitāyā anutpādo na sā prajñāpāramitā.
body.translated_text: For what reason, O venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, do you say this — the non-arising of the perfection of giving (<s>dānapāramitā</s>) is not that perfection of giving; the non-arising of the perfection of morality (<s>śīlapāramitā</s>) is not that perfection of morality; the non-arising of the perfection of patience (<s>kṣāntipāramitā</s>) is not that perfection of patience; the non-arising of the perfection of vigor (<s>vīryapāramitā</s>) is not that perfection of vigor; the non-arising of the perfection of meditation (<s>dhyānapāramitā</s>) is not that perfection of meditation; the non-arising of the perfection of wisdom (<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>) is not that perfection of wisdom.

body.text: kena kāraṇenāyuṣman subhūte evaṃ vadasi, yo 'dhyātmaśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sādhyātmaśūnyatā, yo bahirdhāśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sā bahirdhāśūnyatā, yo 'dhyātmabahirdhāśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sādhyātmabahirdhāśūnyatā, yaḥ śūnyatāśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sā śūnyatāśūnyatā, yo mahāśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sā mahāśūnyatā, yaḥ paramārthaśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sā paramārthaśūnyatā, yaḥ saṃskṛtaśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sā saṃskṛtaśūnyatā, yo 'saṃskṛtaśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sāsaṃskṛtaśūnyatā, yo 'tyantaśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sātyantaśūnyatā, yo navarāgraśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sā navarāgraśūnyatā, yo 'navakāraśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sānavakāraśūnyatā, yaḥ prakṛtiśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sā prakṛtiśūnyatā, yaḥ sarvadharmaśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sā sarvadharmaśūnyatā, yaḥ svalakṣaṇaśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sā svalakṣaṇaśūnyatā, yo 'nupalambhaśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sānupalambhaśūnyatā, yo 'bhāvaśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sābhāvaśūnyatā, yaḥ svabhavaśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sā svabhāvaśūnyatā, yo 'bhāvasvabhāvaśūnyatāyā anutpādo na sābhāvasvabhāvaśūnyatā.
body.translated_text: For what reason, O venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, do you say this — the non-arising of internal emptiness (<s>adhyātmaśūnyatā</s>) is not that internal emptiness; the non-arising of external emptiness (<s>bahirdhāśūnyatā</s>) is not that external emptiness; the non-arising of internal-and-external emptiness (<s>adhyātmabahirdhāśūnyatā</s>) is not that internal-and-external emptiness; the non-arising of the emptiness of emptiness (<s>śūnyatāśūnyatā</s>) is not that emptiness of emptiness; the non-arising of great emptiness (<s>mahāśūnyatā</s>) is not that great emptiness; the non-arising of ultimate emptiness (<s>paramārthaśūnyatā</s>) is not that ultimate emptiness; the non-arising of conditioned emptiness (<s>saṃskṛtaśūnyatā</s>) is not that conditioned emptiness; the non-arising of unconditioned emptiness (<s>asaṃskṛtaśūnyatā</s>) is not that unconditioned emptiness; the non-arising of absolute emptiness (<s>atyantaśūnyatā</s>) is not that absolute emptiness; the non-arising of beginningless-and-endless emptiness (<s>anavarāgraśūnyatā</s>) is not that beginningless-and-endless emptiness; the non-arising of non-rejection emptiness (<s>anavakāraśūnyatā</s>) is not that non-rejection emptiness; the non-arising of natural emptiness (<s>prakṛtiśūnyatā</s>) is not that natural emptiness; the non-arising of the emptiness of all <s>dharma</s>s (<s>sarvadharmaśūnyatā</s>) is not that emptiness of all <s>dharma</s>s; the non-arising of the emptiness of individual characteristics (<s>svalakṣaṇaśūnyatā</s>) is not that emptiness of individual characteristics; the non-arising of the emptiness of non-apprehension (<s>anupalambhaśūnyatā</s>) is not that emptiness of non-apprehension; the non-arising of the emptiness of non-existence (<s>abhāvaśūnyatā</s>) is not that emptiness of non-existence; the non-arising of the emptiness of intrinsic nature (<s>svabhāvaśūnyatā</s>) is not that emptiness of intrinsic nature; the non-arising of the emptiness of non-existent intrinsic nature (<s>abhāvasvabhāvaśūnyatā</s>) is not that emptiness of non-existent intrinsic nature.

body.text: kena kāraṇenāyuṣman subhūte evaṃ vadasi, yaḥ smṛtyupasthānānām anutpādo na tāni smṛtyupasthānāni, yaḥ samyakprahāṇānām anutpādo na tāni samyakprahāṇāni, ya ṛddhipādānām anutpādo na ta ṛddhipādāḥ, ya indriyāṇām anutpādo na tānīndriyāṇi, yo balānām anutpādo na tāni balāni, yo bodhyaṅgānām anutpādo na tāni bodhyaṅgāni, ya āryāṣṭāṅgasyānutpādo na sa āryāṣṭāṅgo mārgaḥ, ya āryasatyānām anutpādo na tāny āryasatyāni, yo dhyānānām anutpādo na tāni dhyānāni, yo 'pramāṇānām anutpādo na tāny apramāṇāni, ya ārūpyasamāpattīnān anutpādo na tā ārūpyasamāpattayaḥ, (

children.text: ) yo vimokṣāṇām anutpādo na te vimokṣāḥ, yo 'nupūrvavihārasamāpattīnām anutpādo na tā anupūrvavihārasamāpattayaḥ, yaḥ śūnyatānimittāpraṇihitavimokṣamukhānām anutpādo na tāni śūnyatānimittāpraṇihitavimokṣamukhāni, ya abhijñānām anutpādo na tā abhijñāḥ, yaḥ samādhīnām anutpādo na te samādhayaḥ, yo dhāraṇīmukhānām anutpādo na tāni dhāraṇīmukhāni, yas tathāgatabalānām anutpādo na tāni tathāgatabalāni, yo vaiśāradyānām antpādo na tāni vaiśāradyāni, yaḥ pratisaṃvidām anutpādo na tā pratisaṃvidaḥ, yo mahāmaitryā anutpādo na sā mahāmaitrī, yo mahākaruṇāyā anutpādo na sā karuṇā, ya āveṇikabuddhadharmāṇām anutpādo na ta āveṇikabuddhadharmāḥ.
children.translated_text: ) the non-arising of the liberations (<s>vimokṣa</s>) is not those liberations; the non-arising of the sequential abiding attainments (<s>anupūrvavihārasamāpatti</s>) is not those sequential abiding attainments; the non-arising of the gates of liberation — emptiness, signlessness, and wishlessness (<s>śūnyatānimittāpraṇihitavimokṣamukha</s>) — is not those gates of liberation; the non-arising of the superknowledges (<s>abhijñā</s>) is not those superknowledges; the non-arising of the concentrations (<s>samādhi</s>) is not those concentrations; the non-arising of the gates of <s>dhāraṇī</s> is not those gates of <s>dhāraṇī</s>; the non-arising of the powers of the <s>Tathāgata</s> is not those powers of the <s>Tathāgata</s>; the non-arising of the fearlessnesses (<s>vaiśāradya</s>) is not those fearlessnesses; the non-arising of the discriminating knowledges (<s>pratisaṃvid</s>) is not those discriminating knowledges; the non-arising of great loving-kindness (<s>mahāmaitrī</s>) is not that great loving-kindness; the non-arising of great compassion (<s>mahākaruṇā</s>) is not that great compassion; the non-arising of the exclusive qualities of the <s>Buddha</s> (<s>āveṇikabuddhadharma</s>) is not those exclusive qualities of the <s>Buddha</s>.

body.translated_text: For what reason, O venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, do you say this — the non-arising of the foundations of mindfulness (<s>smṛtyupasthāna</s>) is not those foundations of mindfulness; the non-arising of the right exertions (<s>samyakprahāṇa</s>) is not those right exertions; the non-arising of the bases of supernatural power (<s>ṛddhipāda</s>) is not those bases of supernatural power; the non-arising of the faculties (<s>indriya</s>) is not those faculties; the non-arising of the powers (<s>bala</s>) is not those powers; the non-arising of the factors of awakening (<s>bodhyaṅga</s>) is not those factors of awakening; the non-arising of the noble eightfold path (<s>āryāṣṭāṅgamārga</s>) is not that noble eightfold path; the non-arising of the noble truths (<s>āryasatya</s>) is not those noble truths; the non-arising of the meditative absorptions (<s>dhyāna</s>) is not those meditative absorptions; the non-arising of the immeasurables (<s>apramāṇa</s>) is not those immeasurables; the non-arising of the formless attainments (<s>ārūpyasamāpatti</s>) is not those formless attainments (

body.text: kena kāraṇenāyuṣman subhūte evaṃ vadasi? yaḥ sarvajñatāyā anutpādo na sā sarvajñatā, yo mārgākārajñatāyā anutpādo na sā mārgākārajñatā, yaḥ sarvākārajñatāyā anutpādo na sā sarvākārajñatā.
body.translated_text: For what reason, O venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, do you say this? The non-arising of omniscience (<s>sarvajñatā</s>) is not that omniscience; the non-arising of the knowledge of path-aspects (<s>mārgākārajñatā</s>) is not that knowledge of path-aspects; the non-arising of the knowledge of all aspects (<s>sarvākārajñatā</s>) is not that knowledge of all aspects.

body.text: subhūtir āha: rūpam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ rūpeṇa yad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ na tad rūpaṃ notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo rūpasyānutpādo na tad rūpaṃ, vedanāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyā vedanayā yad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyā na sā vedanā notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo vedanāyā anutpādo na sā vedanā, saṃjñāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyā saṃjñayā āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyā na sā saṃjñā notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yaḥ saṃjñāyā anutpādo na sā saṃjñā, saṃskārā āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyāḥ saṃskārair ya āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyā na te saṃskārā notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yaḥ saṃskārāṇām anutpādo na te saṃskārāḥ, vijñānam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ vijñāneṇa yad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ na tad vijñānaṃ notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo vijñānasyānutpādo na tad vijñānam.
body.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: Form, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of form. That which, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty — that is not form, nor is it arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of form is not that form. Feeling, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of feeling. That which, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty — that is not feeling, nor is it arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of feeling is not that feeling. Perception, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of perception. That which, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty — that is not perception, nor is it arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of perception is not that perception. Formations, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, are empty of formations. That which, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty — those are not formations, nor is it arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of formations is not those formations. Consciousness, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of consciousness. That which, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty — that is not consciousness, nor is it arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of consciousness is not that consciousness.

body.text: cakṣur āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ cakṣuṣā yad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ na tac cakṣur notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yac cakṣuṣo 'nutpādo na tac cakṣuḥ, śrotram āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ śrotreṇa yad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ na tac chrotraṃ notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yaḥ śrotrasyānutpādo na tac chrotraṃ, ghrāṇam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra (

children.text: ) śūnyaṃ ghrāṇena yad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ na tad ghrāṇaṃ notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo ghrāṇasyānutpādo na tad ghrāṇaṃ, jihvāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyā jihvayā yāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyā na sā jihvā notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo jihvāyā anutpādo na sā jihvā, kāya āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ kāyeṇa ya āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyo na sa kāyo notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yaḥ kāyasyānutpādo na sa kāyaḥ, mana āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ manasā yad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ na tan mano notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo manaso 'nutpādo na tan manaḥ.
children.translated_text: ) The nose, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty by the nose; what, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty is not the nose, and is not arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of the nose is not the nose. The tongue, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty by the tongue; what, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty is not the tongue, and is not arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of the tongue is not the tongue. The body, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty by the body; what, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty is not the body, and is not arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of the body is not the body. The mind, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty by the mind; what, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty is not the mind, and is not arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of the mind is not the mind.

By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of the eye is not that eye. The ear, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of the ear. body.text: rūpam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ rūpeṇa yad āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ na tad rūpaṃ notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo rūpasyānutpādo na tad rūpaṃ, śabda āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaḥ śabdena, yaś ca śūnyo na sa śabdo notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yaḥ śabdasyānutpādo na sa śabdaḥ, gandha āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyo gandhena yaś ca śūnyo na sa gandho notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo gandhasyānutpādo na sa gandhaḥ, rasa āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyo rasena yaś ca śūnyo na sa raso notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo rasasyānutpādo na sa rasaḥ, sparśa āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaḥ sparśena, yaś ca śūnyo na sa sparśo notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yaḥ sparśasyānutpādo na sa sparśaḥ, dharmā āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyā dharmair ye ca śūnyā na te dharmā notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo dharṃānām anutpādo na te dharmāḥ.
body.translated_text: Visible form, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty by visible form; what, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty is not that visible form, and is not arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of visible form is not that visible form. Sound, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty by sound; what is empty is not that sound, and is not arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of sound is not that sound. Smell, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty by smell; what is empty is not that smell, and is not arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of smell is not that smell. Taste, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty by taste; what is empty is not that taste, and is not arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of taste is not that taste. Tangible objects, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, are empty by tangible objects; what is empty is not that tangible object, and is not arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of tangible objects is not that tangible object. <s>Dharma</s>s (mental objects), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, are empty by <s>dharma</s>s; what is empty is not those <s>dharma</s>s, and is not arising. By this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of <s>dharma</s>s is not those <s>dharma</s>s.

body.text: pṛthivīdhātur āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaḥ pṛthivīdhātunā, yaś ca śūnyo na sa pṛthivīdhātur notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yaḥ pṛthivīdhātor anutpādo na sa pṛthivīdhātuḥ, abdhātur āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyo 'bdhātunā, yaś ca śūnyo na so 'bdhātur notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo 'bdhātor anutpādo na so 'bdhātuḥ, tejodhātur āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyas tejodhātunā, yaś ca śūnyo na sa tejodhātur notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yas tejodhātor anutpādo na sa tejodhātuḥ, vāyudhātur āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyo vāyudhātunā, yaś ca śūnyo na sa vāyudhātur notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo vāyudhātor anutpādo na sa vāyudhātuḥ, ākāśadhātur āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyo ākāśadhātunā, yaś ca śūnyo na sa ākāśadhātur notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa ya ākāśadhātor anutpādo na sa ākāśadhātuḥ, vijñānadhātur āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyo vijñānadhātunā, yaś ca śūnyo na sa vijñānadhātur notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo vijñānadhātor anutpādo na sa vijñānadhātuḥ.

body.text: avidyāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyo avidyayā, yā ca śūnyā na sāvidyā notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo avidyāyā anutpādo na sāvidyā, saṃskārā āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyāḥ saṃskārair, ye ca śūnyā na te saṃskārā notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yaḥ saṃskārāṇām anutpādo na te saṃskārāḥ vijñānam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ vijñānena, yac ca śūnyaṃ na tad vijñānaṃ notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo vijñānasyānutpādo na tad vijñānaṃ, nāmarūpam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ nāmarūpeṇa, yac ca śūnyaṃ na tan nāmarūpaṃ notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo nāmarūpasyānutpādo na tan nāmarūpaṃ, ṣaḍāyatanam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaṃ ṣaḍāyatanena, yac ca śūnyaṃ na tat ṣaḍāyatanaṃ notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yaḥ ṣaḍāyatanasyānutpādo na tat ṣaḍāyatanaṃ, sparśa āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyaḥ sparśena, yaś ca śūnyo na sa sparśo notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yaḥ sparśasyānutpādo na sa sparśaḥ, vedanāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyo vedanayā, yā ca śūnyā na sā vedanā notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo vedanāyām anutpādo na sā vedanā, tṛṣṇāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyā tṛṣṇayā, yā ca śūnyā na sā tṛṣṇā notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yas tṛṣṇāyā anutpādo na sā tṛṣṇā, upādānam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyam upādānena, yac ca śūnyaṃ na tad upādānaṃ notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yad upādānasyānutpādo na tad upādānaṃ, bhava āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyo bhavena, yaś ca śūnyo na sa bhavo notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo bhavasyānutpādo na sa bhavaḥ, jātir āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyā jātyā, yā ca śūnyā na sā jātir notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo jāter anutpādo na sā jātiḥ, jarāmaraṇam āyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra śūnyā jarāmaraṇena, yac ca śūnyaṃ na taj jarāmaraṇaṃ notpādaḥ, anenāyuṣmañ chāradvatīputra paryāyeṇa yo jarāmaraṇasyānutpādo na taj jarāmaraṇam.
body.translated_text: Ignorance (<s>avidyā</s>), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of ignorance, and what is empty is not that ignorance and is non-arising; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of ignorance is not that ignorance. Formations (<s>saṃskāra</s>), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, are empty of formations, and what is empty is not those formations and is non-arising; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of formations is not those formations. Consciousness (<s>vijñāna</s>), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of consciousness, and what is empty is not that consciousness and is non-arising; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of consciousness is not that consciousness. Name-and-form (<s>nāmarūpa</s>), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of name-and-form, and what is empty is not that name-and-form and is non-arising; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of name-and-form is not that name-and-form. The six sense-bases (<s>ṣaḍāyatana</s>), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, are empty of the six sense-bases, and what is empty is not those six sense-bases and is non-arising; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of the six sense-bases is not those six sense-bases. Contact (<s>sparśa</s>), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of contact, and what is empty is not that contact and is non-arising; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of contact is not that contact. Feeling (<s>vedanā</s>), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of feeling, and what is empty is not that feeling and is non-arising; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of feeling is not that feeling. Craving (<s>tṛṣṇā</s>), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of craving, and what is empty is not that craving and is non-arising; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of craving is not that craving. Clinging (<s>upādāna</s>), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of clinging, and what is empty is not that clinging and is non-arising; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of clinging is not that clinging. Existence (<s>bhava</s>), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of existence, and what is empty is not that existence and is non-arising; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of existence is not that existence. Birth (<s>jāti</s>), O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, is empty of birth, and what is empty is not that birth and is non-arising; by this method, O venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s>, the non-arising of birth is not that birth.
